name: Hide Comments
description: Collapse comment sections and discussion blocks on noisy pages.
script: (function() { let affected = 0; const selectors = ['#comments', 'ytd-comments', '[data-testid="comments"]', '.comments', '#comment', '.comment-thread']; selectors.forEach(sel => { try { document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => { if (el.style.display !== 'none') { el.style.display = 'none'; affected++; } }); } catch (e) {} }); return affected; })();
